responses.reservation: Both signature deltas are structurally justified, not gratuitous: (1) pd — listProductionAutoDecisions requires projectDir to resolve against workspace intents.json (amadeus-autonomy-review-production.ts:296-310), which recordDir cannot supply without fragile path walk-up, and the call site already captures completionRecordDir once before cursor-clearing mutations (amadeus-state.ts:3305-3308), so threading the already-available pd is more robust than re-derivation; (2) Result-ification — domain-entities.md's own invariant at line 33 (『生成失敗は SummaryBuildError を経て completion JSON の警告フィールドへ落ちるのみ』) presupposes the exact Result channel the line-7 pin forbids, i.e. the FD is internally self-contradictory, and phases/construction.md:14-15 mandates propagating/logging errors at integration boundaries rather than swallowing them. Given this, B's remedy is correctly scoped to record-only correction. But the remediation must explicitly fix code-summary.md:42, which currently states 『FDのR-1〜R-8の範囲を超える変更は見当たらない』 — this is inaccurate since the domain-entities.md pin at line 7 (a distinct FD contract from R-1~R-8) was in fact violated and never disclosed as a deviation. The record fix must (a) name this as a disclosed deviation with the structural rationale above, (b) correct the domain-entities.md pin itself to remove its internal self-contradiction (align the signature with the SummaryBuildError/invariant text it already carries), and (c) add the R-4/R-6/R-7 traceability notes B's label specifies. Absent that correction, this ruling would leave a document that still visibly contradicts merged code.
responses.rationale: Evidence chain: amadeus-autonomy-review-production.ts:308-321 (listProductionAutoDecisions signature requires projectDir, calls resolveReviewTarget(input.projectDir, ...) against intents.json) confirms pd cannot be cleanly reconstructed from recordDir alone within existing codebase convention. amadeus-state.ts:3225-3236,3305-3308 shows pd was already in caller scope and recordDir was deliberately captured once pre-cursor-clear, making direct pd threading the safer choice over path-walkup re-derivation. domain-entities.md:5-7 pins a bare SummaryDoc-returning signature and says 'don't refine,' but domain-entities.md:18-21 (SummaryBuildError type, present in the SAME pinned code block) and domain-entities.md:33 (invariant: failures flow through SummaryBuildError to a warning field) already require a Result-shaped return — the FD document contradicts itself before implementation ever began. component-methods.md:3 sets an intent-wide default of 'エラー処理は既定で Result/判別ユニオン + fail-closed' that C9's one-liner (component-methods.md:92) never explicitly overrides. phases/construction.md:14-15: 'エラーは呼び出し元へ伝播させるかログに記録する — サイレントな失敗は許容しない' directly supports Result-based propagation of the listProductionAutoDecisions integration-boundary failure over silent absorption. amadeus-completion-report.ts:1-7,111-119 shows the implementation coherently threads this Result type through buildAutoDecisionSummary and writeAutoDecisionSummaryMarkdown into formatSummaryBuildError (lines 189-198), consistent with R-3's non-blocking warning-field design. The genuine defect is process, not engineering: code-summary.md:42 falsely claims no deviation beyond R-1~R-8, which the domain-entities.md:5-7 pin (a distinct FD contract) contradicts. That gap is exactly what choice B's record-only remedy is built to close, without discarding a signature that is more guardrail-compliant than the one it replaced.
